data.exact_reserve_text: The movement in the net provision for claims includes a release of $6,284,000 in respect of claims outstanding at the previous year end (2014: release $7,492,000). The release comprises net claim reductions including the change in claims incurred but not reported ('IBNR').

data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2015 the syndicate reported opening gross claims outstanding of $446.119m. Analysis of the gross claims development triangle shows a net adverse prior-year development (gross strengthening) of approximately $23.4m (around 5.2% of opening gross claims), driven by adverse development on older underwriting years (notably developments through 2013 and earlier) and individual large/man-made losses (notably in Energy and Aviation). The accounts also record a net release on the net provision for claims of $6.284m (after reinsurance) driven in part by IBNR movements and net recoveries, producing mixed signals between gross deterioration and net release once reinsurance is considered.

data.data_quality_notes: Primary prior-year development amount was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (gross values in $000) because the explicit movement note in the accounts only cited a NET release ($6.284m) rather than a GROSS prior-year movement. The triangle-based gross PYD (approx +$23.366m) may differ from net figures after reinsurance; net release of $6.284m is recorded in the notes. All monetary amounts are in the report's functional currency (USD). Some named event years are approximate where the report did not provide explicit event years. Confidence levels reflect where figures were directly stated (1.0), calculated from the triangle (0.8) or inferred (0.5-0.7).
